title: Federation link to Mac and Windows B lost again after the 2026-10-29 build restart (repeated 409 'federation link changed')
outcome: After a routine build restart of Central and/or a satellite, an enrolled satellite's authenticated mailbox link recovers automatically, with no re-pairing or operator action; a link-incarnation change during credential read or basis validation converges instead of looping on 409 'federation link changed'.
acceptance: A cause note identifies the stale literal-IP endpoints after LAN renumbering, the exact local no-link source of the repeated Mac relay 409, and the relationship to prior fix 00a4ecea and its open children, with file and line.

Stored federation endpoints migrate safely to hostnames without re-pairing; names are re-resolved on each connection; fallback and recovery remain bound to the pinned host key, host UUID and enrollment, not to the address.

Deterministic tests cover hostname dialing and safe migration with enrollment and keys preserved, refusal of a different host key, recovery across restart or credential/basis changes, and mailbox placement/reference behavior across the address transition.
The deferred native relay drains automatically once the link returns, with deterministic coverage preserving its message, sequence and acknowledgment boundaries.
The exact input passes an independent review pair and the full five-stage gate before landing.
